Update Tomi to be able to disconnect. Nothing has been erased.
Your Tomi server refused the disconnection. Nothing has been erased: this phone stays in your space.
This is the only device. Disconnecting deletes your space and everything in it, permanently.
Your Tomi server erases the space, then this phone erases everything it holds: items, hidden content, files and keys. No one will be able to recover them.

Update Tomi to be able to delete your space. Nothing has been erased.
Your Tomi server refused to delete the space. Nothing has been erased.
To delete your space, set up a screen lock (code, fingerprint or face) in the phone settings. Nothing has been erased.
Tomi is checking with your server. Nothing has been erased.
Your Tomi server has not confirmed yet. Nothing has been erased. Tomi tries again as soon as the network is back.
Your Tomi server has a temporary problem. Nothing has been erased. Tomi is trying again.
Your request did not go through: this phone is still part of your space. Nothing has been erased.
Your Tomi server can no longer find your space, or no longer recognizes this phone. Nothing has been erased.
Tomi is waiting for the request already sent to your server to finish. Nothing will be erased on this phone.
Disconnection canceled. If your server had already received it, this phone will appear as removed from the space; what it holds stays readable.
Deletion canceled. If your server had already done it, your space now exists only on this phone.
Erasing did not complete. Nothing has been erased. Try again.
Your Tomi server can no longer find your space. If it has been reset, you can erase this phone; otherwise, check your server first. Nothing has been erased on this phone.
This phone has been removed from your space. What it holds stays readable here. Disconnecting erases it.
Erase this phone without confirmation from the server?
Your Tomi server cannot confirm that your space is deleted. The space may not be deleted on your server; if it still exists, this phone will no longer have access to it.
Everything this phone holds will be permanently erased: items, hidden content, files and keys.
Tomi is checking with your server…
